title: Steamed Australian Prawns in Khus Broth
description: A light and refreshing French-inspired prawn dish, served in a khus broth. Perfect for a warm evening.
instructions: 1. Rinse the prawns under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
2. In a large bowl, combine the khus grass, lightly steamed water, salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine.
3. Bring the khus broth to a simmer over medium heat.
4. Add the prawns to the khus broth and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they are pink and cooked through.
5. Remove the prawns from the broth with a slotted spoon and place on a plate.
6. Strain the khus broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean bowl, discarding the solids.
7. Serve the prawns in the khus broth, garnished with chopped parsley and lemon wedges.
